name: Mikenokouji Yae
source:
The young lady of the Mikenokouji family. To outsiders, she appears slightly old-fashioned(?) and has an elegant air about her.

Wanting to be of service to others(?), she begins working part-time at a convenience store under the same family's group. She personally intends to hide her identity and work incognito, but she's spectacularly obvious about it.

True to her appearance, she's exceptionally bad at lies and deception. As she becomes more conscious of the protagonist, her shyness and timid nature regarding romance lead to trouble...

She's the most gentle-natured heroine, and doesn't seem particularly bothered by frequently tripping or failing. But is her ability to suddenly trip even on flat ground a natural talent?

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/tenmus/yae.html]official site[/url]]
